version: g3_body_v3 (build 4 of 4; final rebuild for a material-slot fix only, geometry identical)
source_script: world/vehicles/sedan_body.py + world/vehicles/build_sedan_v2.py (renders: qa_render.py, arch_crops.py, new zebra_render.py)
coordinate_system: Blender: origin on the ground at the wheelbase centre, +Y front, +Z up, +X right (= dimension-sheet frame). Exported Y-up (export_yup=True), so Godot -Z is the car front.

bounds_m.note: with placeholder wheels; body shell alone z 0.165..1.448. Nose 2.325 / tail -2.475 are on the sheet to the mm.

Body: BlackTrim (window-surround walls, aperture floors and walls)
Glass: BlackTrim (ceramic band, one boundary face row 15-35 mm)

objects_and_insets.Glass: one object, 6 components: windscreen and rear screen 5 mm inboard along the shell normal, 4 side-glass panels 12 mm inboard; side glass trimmed by the raked A-pillar line (belt y 0.82 -> cant y 0.18) and the forward-leaning C-pillar line (belt y -1.325 -> cant y -1.04); screens trimmed by plan-view side lines (windscreen x 0.745 at the base -> 0.625 at the header; rear screen 0.66 -> 0.56).
objects_and_insets.BPillar: band y -0.316..-0.218 (98 mm incl. the 14 mm normal inset), belt to cant rail, 14 mm inboard (2 mm behind the glass), BlackTrim.
objects_and_insets.window_surround: 728 rim edges of the daylight opening extruded inboard (5 mm at the screens, 12 mm at the side glass, 14 mm at the pillar), BlackTrim, sharp edges.

apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.headlamp L/R: y 1.84 .. nose, z 0.65..0.80, |x| >= 0.48, wraps the corner onto the nose face; 9 mm floor; the hood leading-edge gap (y 2.08) ends on the lamp cut line
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.grille: |x| < 0.48, z 0.56..0.72 on the nose face; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.lower_intake: |x| < 0.50, z 0.25..0.39 on the BumperSkirt; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.tail_lamp L/R: y -2.00 .. tail, z 0.79..0.95, |x| 0.32..0.85, wraps onto the rear face; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.mirror_pad L/R: |x| > 0.78, y 0.72..0.88, z 0.98..1.03 (sail area ahead of the A-pillar glass line); 2 mm recess

surface_changes_vs_G2_v2p: P2-1: front lower chamfer applied along the corner normal (part of the lift becomes an inward pull in x for |x|/(W/2) > 0.55) - corner rolls, no diagonal fold in clay_front / clay_front_34 / zebra_hood
P2-2: arch-wall foot raised to the sill-bottom height (FLOOR_Z+0.045) and the liner kept 50-90 mm inside the subdivided wall - no tabs below the sill in arch_front_left / arch_rear_left (833 px/m)
P2-3: shoulder line 0.80 (y 2.0) -> 0.83 (y 0, front handle) -> 0.865 (y -1.15, rear handle) -> 0.95 (y -2.0); measured on the mesh at max-x: 0.799 / 0.831 / 0.865 / 0.947
P3-4: nose 2.325 (end stations pinned; the subdivided end sits on the last ring station)
P3-11: all stations now measured from the sheet nose (Y_NOSE), shut lines at y 0.96 / -0.27 / -1.34 exactly
P3-7/8: greenhouse ring parametrisation blended into the hood/trunk layout over the last 0.30 m before the cowl and behind the screen base (no cage twist at the station boundary)
P3-12: trunk lid falls continuously 1.10 -> 1.02 (t^1.2) with a creased lid lip 0.17 m from the tail
hood: power dome, two soft ridges at x = +-0.15, ~7 mm, cowl to 0.3 m behind the nose; hood leading-edge gap moved to y 2.08 and terminated on the headlamp cut
DLO: recessed glass with black window surround, A/B/C pillars as geometry
reference_ids: production/references/dimension_sheet.json (stations, DLO, apertures, handles, shoulder line, b_pillar_y, door edges)

zebra_reflection_strips: zebra_left.png (5 strips along the car, ortho left)
zebra_hood.png (5 strips across the car, front-left above)

known_defects: Side-glass front-top corner: a 2-step stair (~2 cm) where the A-pillar plane cut meets the cant-rail edge (clay_left x~535-545 y~235-250; clay_right x~350-370 y~240-270).
Rear-door glass top rear corner: small hook where the door-shut groove ends at the cant rail and meets the recessed glass corner (clay_rear_34 x~700-720 y~300-330).
Grille floor: faint un-recessed facet at the cage pole (x 0, z~0.57) seen in build 3; reduced in build 4 (bisect dist 1.5 mm) - eye-check.
Ceramic band is one subdivided face row (15-35 mm), not a constant 15 mm; the inset-based band was abandoned because it produced fins on the cut edges.
B-pillar band 98 mm wide incl. inset (brief 60-80).
Plane cuts leave 145 n-gons on Body, 8 on Glass, 10 on BumperSkirt; weighted normals applied with sharp aperture/surround edges - G7 to triangulate/clean.
Rear screen 21.7-23 deg (sheet landmarks themselves give 21.7 deg); not changed.
Headlamp inner edge on the nose is the hood-gap end at |x|~0.58 rather than the sheet's 0.48 - the hood groove terminates there by design.
Windscreen/rear-screen recess depth (5 mm) and side glass (12 mm) are by construction along stored shell normals, not re-measured on the export.
Placeholder wheels/rims remain for proportion; the G4 wheel assembly replaces them.
